hero.badge: A safe AI presence engine for Japanese local businesses
hero.title: Make your company discoverable — on Google search and in AI (ChatGPT & Gemini) alike.

AI continuously generates articles and structured data, while a safe operating model keeps higher-risk publishing under human approval — growing your visibility across both search engines and generative AI.
hero.disruption: Ads vanish the moment you stop paying. The discoverability you build with PresenceVision endures as a lasting asset.

effects.label: What to expect
items: More opportunities to be cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity

simple.title: Leave the hard stuff to AI.
simple.subtitle: All you do is enter your company's website address. After that, AI writes articles and information about your business online every day, so people keep finding you on Google, ChatGPT, and maps.

step1.title: Enter your URL
step1.desc: Just type in your company's website address. No technical know-how needed.

step2.title: AI works automatically
step2.desc: Around the clock, AI creates articles, FAQs, and company information, then publishes them to your pages and (if you connect it) your Google Business Profile.

step3.title: Become a company people find
step3.desc: Over time, your business starts showing up on Google search, in AI tools like ChatGPT, and on maps.

g1.label: More articles
g1.desc: Articles keep building up on your own public page (Knowledge Hub), your own website / WordPress, and (once connected) your Google Business Profile.

g2.label: Never stops
g2.desc: AI keeps working while you sleep and on your days off.

g3.label: Multilingual
g3.desc: English, Japanese, and audiences abroad, all handled automatically.

g4.label: Safe by design
g4.desc: A person checks anything risky before it goes live, preventing mistakes and false information.

simple.resultsTitle: See your results in real numbers
simple.resultsDesc: Search rankings, mentions in AI, the number of published articles, and engagement all appear in your dashboard every day as real data. You can track your progress with facts, not just a vague feeling. Note: because search rankings and AI mentions depend on outside factors, we don't guarantee specific numbers, but we show your actions and results transparently.

cta.bottomTitle: Your first step to becoming a discoverable company in the AI era
cta.bottomSubtitle: After registering your payment details, try every feature free for 7 days. Cancel anytime.

features.sectionTitle: 6 features that make your company discoverable
features.sectionSubtitle: From keyword discovery to content and structured data generation, safe publishing, and tracking of search rankings and AI citations. Japanese-optimized AI runs it all, continuously.

keyword.title: Automatic Long-Tail Keyword Discovery
keyword.desc: Automatically gathers the exact words your prospects use from Google search suggestions and related questions. Surfaces local, industry-specific search terms with real demand to serve as the foundation for your articles.

content.title: Automatic Content & Structured Data Generation
content.desc: AI generates articles, FAQs, company overviews, and Schema.org markup (Organization / LocalBusiness / FAQ). Everything is shaped to be easily understood — and easily cited — by both search engines and generative AI.

distribution.title: Safe Publishing (Your Own Hub & Your Site)
distribution.desc: Officially publish to your own knowledge Hub (a public page dedicated to you) and to your own WordPress / CMS. We also support Google Business Profile integration (connection-based) and structured data. We do not run impersonating, automated posts to third-party social networks in violation of their terms.

llmMonitoring.title: GEO (AI Citation) Monitoring
llmMonitoring.desc: Track how Perplexity, Google AI Overview, and others introduce and cite your company. Visualize how you appear in generative AI search and use those insights to improve.

serp.title: Search Ranking Tracking & Automatic Strategy Adjustment
serp.desc: Track how your Google search rankings move after publishing. Understand which articles are gaining traction and which aren't, and let AI recommend the content you should create next.

autonomous.title: 24/7 Autonomous Operation + Human Approval
autonomous.desc: The engine runs a continuous loop of research, generation, (approval,) and publishing around the clock. Autonomous yet safe by design: you can require human approval for any publish that carries risk.

howItWorks.title: Get Started in 4 Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Just enter your company details and URL. AI generates the plan from there and runs continuously, under safe operation.

step1.title: Register Your Company Info
step1.desc: Register your company overview, URL, target area, and keywords. Start using the service after existence verification.

step2.title: AI Generates the Plan
step2.desc: Automatically builds a plan: keyword discovery → article and structured data generation → publishing.

step3.title: Publish Safely (Hub & Your Site)
step3.desc: Publish to your own Hub and your site. Each article ships with structured data, making it easy for generative AI to cite.

step4.title: Your Presence Grows
step4.desc: Search rankings, AI citations, and local search visibility improve continuously.

hubSpoke.title: The Hub & Spoke Model
hubSpoke.subtitle: Your company information is the home base (the hub). Search, maps, and AI all come to reference it.
hubSpoke.explanation: Publish your articles and company information — complete with structured data — to your own knowledge Hub and your site. When your Google Business Profile, company directory, and FAQs all cross-reference one another, both search engines and generative AI come to recognize you as a trustworthy primary source. No reliance on impersonating posts to third-party social networks in violation of their terms.

channels.title: Safe Publishing Destinations
channels.subtitle: Your own Hub, your own site / CMS, Google Business Profile, and structured data. We do not run automated posts to third-party social networks in violation of their terms.

pricing.title: Simple Pricing Plans
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes Japanese GEO optimization, structured data, and human approval before publishing.
pricing.aiBoostDesc: High-quality article generation powered by Claude Opus 4.8. Produces original, citation-worthy articles with a strong emphasis on E-E-A-T.

trust.title: Amplifying only trusted entities, the right way
trust.subtitle: PresenceVision is not a stealth marketing tool. It is a platform that increases the visibility of real, high-quality products and services with full transparency and legal compliance.

verified.title: Verified Entity Only
verified.desc: Only entities that pass corporate verification, official website validation, and real service screening can use the platform. Anonymous or fictitious brands are not permitted.

evidence.title: Evidence-Required Publishing
evidence.desc: Content without primary sources, official data, academic papers, or news references is automatically blocked from publishing. Unsubstantiated claims and exaggerations are detected and filtered.

score.title: Entity Trust Score
score.desc: Continuous scoring based on news citations, external links, social media mentions, and verified business ratings. Low-scoring entities face distribution restrictions.

stealth.title: Act against Unjustifiable Premiums and Misleading Representations (Japan)
stealth.desc: Fully compliant with Japan's stealth marketing regulation enacted October 2023. All generated content includes proper disclosures to prevent consumer deception.

ftc.title: FTC Endorsement Guides (US)
ftc.desc: Compliant with the U.S. Federal Trade Commission's Endorsement Guidelines. Clear distinction between advertising and organic content is strictly enforced.

dsa.title: EU Digital Services Act
dsa.desc: Adheres to transparency requirements under the EU Digital Services Act. Proper disclosure is maintained for all content distribution on platforms.

google.title: Google Search Essentials
google.desc: Content generation and distribution follows Google Search Essentials (formerly Webmaster Guidelines). No spam policy violations are employed.

adDiff.title: How we differ from "ad optimization AI"
adDiff.subtitle: AI ad tools like Claude Ads make your ads smarter. PV makes ads unnecessary.

whenStopped.label: When stopped?
whenStopped.ad: Ads disappear, traffic drops to zero
whenStopped.pv: Content remains, rankings and AI citations persist

output.label: Output
output.pv: Search #1 + AI citations + natural presence across 25+ channels

adDiff.complementNote: Ads are effective for short-term acquisition. PV builds organic presence over time, gradually reducing ad dependency to zero — that is the PresenceVision philosophy.
